FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 90
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/19/2024
Senate Bill 90 as introduced would provide that all fines and other monies collected from food
service establishments violating country of origin labeling requirements for certain seafood shall
be distributed to the Alabama Department of Public Health to implement this program. This bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
